description: VN→ZH negation transfer: Vietnamese 'không' is a single negator for every tense, but Mandarin uses 没(有) for a COMPLETED event and 不 for habitual/future/volition/states. The 没-vs-不 contrast is aspect (completion), not tense. Learners carry the single VN form over and write '昨天我不去' for a completed event. Rule zh-past-negation-bu-mei rewrites 不 → 没 only when a BOUNDED-OCCASION marker (昨天/前天/刚才/刚刚) co-occurs with 不 immediately before a closed action verb.
fp_risk_note: Medium risk, tightly scoped. Fires only when a bounded-occasion marker (昨天/前天/刚才/刚刚) is present AND 不 immediately precedes a closed action verb (去来吃喝看买卖做说写听见到回找). Habitual/durational markers (以前/去年/上周/上个月) are EXCLUDED because 不 is often correct with them ('以前他不吃肉' = used to not eat meat). Stative/modal/copula 不 (不高兴/不想/不是/不会/不喜欢) is out of scope because those verbs are not in the action set. 不 with no bounded marker ('我不去', habitual) abstains.

positive.notes: Bounded marker 昨天 + action verb 去: 不去 → 没去 (completed event).
Bounded marker 刚才 + action verb 吃: 不吃 → 没吃.
Bounded marker 前天 + action verb 买: 不买 → 没买.

negative.notes: No bounded marker — habitual/future 不去 is correct, must abstain.
Stative adjective 高兴 keeps 不 even with a bounded marker — not an action verb, must abstain.
Modal/volition 想 ('did not want to go') keeps 不 — 不 lands on 想, not in the action set, must abstain.
Copula negation 不是 keeps 不 even with a bounded marker — 是 is not an action verb, must abstain.
Modal ability 不会 ('couldn't speak yet') keeps 不 — 会 is not an action verb (double-guarded: 那时候 is not a bounded marker), must abstain.
Habitual-past 以前他不吃肉 ('used to not eat meat') keeps 不 — 以前 is a habitual/durational marker, deliberately excluded from the trigger, must abstain.
Stative 喜欢 ('did not use to like') keeps 不 — both the habitual marker 以前 and the non-action verb spare it, must abstain.
